text: {"lessons":["Ten periods of mixed results are too little to prove I can beat the market; compare long-run returns with a suitable market benchmark.","My trades have sometimes sold at losses and gains, but price versus my cost is not itself a reason to sell; act on updated prospects and a clear plan.","Most periods I held steady, and my account still grew overall; avoid changing positions without a strong case, while keeping diversification and cash in mind."]}
